name: CANDOR-10 - Human Approval and Action Gateway

parameters.content:
## CANDOR-10 — Human Approval & Action Gateway

Scope (Master Instructions §13): present a candidate's real, freshly-generated CANDOR-07 briefing to a human reviewer, and record their decision — durably, auditably, tied to who decided and when.

Out of scope: CANDOR-10 never executes reject/advance/contact/share. It only calls CANDOR-07 (read-only, to generate the briefing text) and appends one new record to candor08-decisions.jsonl (append-only, never overwrites CANDOR-08's own file).

Page 1 (Form Trigger): candidate_id. Between pages: calls CANDOR-07 as a sub-workflow (fails loud on an unknown candidate_id via CANDOR-07's own IntakeBriefingInputs check — no duplicated lookup logic here). Page 2 (Form): shows the real briefing + collects decision/decider identity/notes. After submission: builds and appends the decision record.

parameters.formDescription: Enter a candidate ID to view their CANDOR-07 briefing and record your decision. This form only records what you decide — it never executes reject, advance, contact, or share actions on your behalf (Master Instructions §13).

options.formDescription: This decision will be recorded, not executed. Reject/advance/contact/share remain the reviewer's own separate actions (Master Instructions §13).

parameters.completionMessage: Your decision has been recorded. No action has been taken automatically - any next step (reject, advance, contact, share) remains yours to carry out separately.
